definition: Euclidean distance from the acting player to the closest visible opponent. NaN when the actor is not locatable in the freeze frame.

Number of visible opponents within 10 m of the acting player.
Number of visible opponents within 15 m of the acting player.

Number of visible opponents within 15 m of the acting player and inside a forward cone of 30 degrees half-angle about the line from the ball to the goal centre (120, 40). Counts opponents who are both near and goal-side, which a plain radius does not distinguish.
Number of visible opponents with a larger x than the acting player, i.e. between the ball and the opponent's goal line.
Number of visible opponents with a larger x than the acting player and with y inside the penalty-area corridor (18 <= y <= 62). A count of the defenders actually obstructing the path to goal.
Total visible opponents in the freeze frame. Partly a coverage measure: see the coverage table and the visibility controls in the paper.
Total visible teammates in the freeze frame, excluding the actor.

The action's END location is inside the opponent's penalty area. Unlike the other zone flags this describes the destination, not the origin.
The action's END location satisfies x >= 80.
Shoelace area of the StatsBomb visible-area polygon, converted to square metres.
visible_area_m2 divided by the full pitch area of 7140 m^2.

Shortest distance from the acting player to any edge of the visible-area polygon. Small values mean the actor's surroundings are partly outside the camera view, so the opponent counts near her are under-estimates.
Total players with a recorded location in the freeze frame, both teams.
Default for actions in the own third (x <= 40 in SPADL coordinates), unless overridden below.
Default for actions in the middle third.
Default for actions in the attacking third (x >= 70 in SPADL coordinates).
Overrides the zone default: a defensive action (tackle, interception, clearance, block or foul) in the own third immediately after a possession change.
Overrides the above: any action within five seconds of the start of a possession that began with a recovery or a counter-attack.
Highest priority: any action that is itself a restart, or the first action of a possession beginning from one.
